📖 Explanation:

The 2003 Brazilian Grand Prix was red-flagged on lap 56 following major crashes involving Mark Webber and Fernando Alonso. Race control initially counted back the results to lap 53, placing McLaren's Kimi Räikkönen in first place.

However, timing telemetry later proved Giancarlo Fisichella had crossed the line to start lap 56 before the red flag was shown, requiring the countback to be taken from lap 54 when he led.

The FIA held an extraordinary court hearing in Paris five days later, officially correcting the result and handing Jordan GP their final Formula 1 victory.
